header:
theorem commutator_spectral_maximum {r : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (X : Square r) :
    ∃ (lam : ℝ) (Y : Square r), 0 ≤ lam ∧ Y ≠ 0 ∧
      commutatorT X Y = (lam : ℂ) • Y ∧
      ∀ Z : Square r, frobeniusNorm (commutator X Z) ^ 2 ≤ lam * frobeniusNorm Z ^ 2 := by
route: Finite-dimensional Rayleigh supremum for the actual entry-space Gram operator yields a nonzero eigenvector. Gram energy proves nonnegative supremum and its universal squared-Frobenius bound. Flattening transports the actual eigenvector and adjoint equation to matrices.
